source.title: 2024 Continental Championship Applications (African, Asian, Oceanic, South American)
source.content:
In [September of 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/applications-for-wca-continental-championships-2024-october-2022), the Board of Directors requested applications for host cities for the following  Championships:

* WCA African Championship 2024
* WCA Asian Championship 2024
* WCA Oceanic Championship 2024
* WCA South American Championship 2024

As no bids were received for the above competitions prior to the application deadline of November 30th, 2022, the Board will make a secondary application period available later in 2023.  

Please stay tuned for more information on the new timeline soon.

translation.title: 2024 年非洲、亚洲、大洋洲及南美洲锦标赛申办进展
translation.content:
[2022 年 9 月](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/applications-for-wca-continental-championships-2024-october-2022)，WCA 董事会曾征集以下锦标赛的举办城市：

* 2024 WCA 非洲锦标赛
* 2024 WCA 亚洲锦标赛
* 2024 WCA 大洋洲锦标赛
* 2024 WCA 南美洲锦标赛

截至 2022 年 11 月 30 日申请截止，上述赛事均未收到申办方案。因此，董事会将在 2023 年稍后再次开放申请。

新的时间安排将于近期公布，敬请关注。
